fusions.name: Hind-Leg Kick
fusions.desc: A rear kick that deals 13 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Antler Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunging strike that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Startled Leap
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you leap 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Alert Stride
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your crit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
